method_note: REPRODUCIBLE audit of prior frozen internal machine issue #28 for completed W40 against final Master Monday and 168 observed hours. All 12 required parameters are scored in supplied order using SUPPORTED=100, MIXED=50 and CONTRADICTED=0. The five prior structural calls average 70% as an internal forecast audit, not a public Market / Structure accuracy measure. Public continuity is the equal-weight mean of all 12 scores, 1000/12=83.33%; it is not investment performance. Price Ranges retain their existing precision rule: each of eight frozen BTC/ETH weekly or day-window envelopes receives credit only when both observed extrema fit. All eight fit, so price-range precision is 100%. Descriptive timing is assessed separately in intraday parameter scores. Decision utility has no supplied execution outcome or rubric. The supplied prospective bridge targets W39, not W40 or W41.
misses: The prior volatile-consolidation/retest framing underweighted W40's BTC-led 2.44% weekly advance and positive late-week USD path, although no confirmed breakdown followed.

Sustained participation across individual large-, mid-, small- and microcap tiers cannot be independently verified from the supplied final evidence; the granular handoff calls receive partial rather than full credit.
